appointments_email_check.name: appointments_email_check
appointments_email_check.value: "appointments"."email" is null or char_length("appointments"."email") between 3 and 254

appointments_clinic_note_check.name: appointments_clinic_note_check
appointments_clinic_note_check.value: "appointments"."clinic_note" is null or char_length("appointments"."clinic_note") between 1 and 500

charges_status_check.name: charges_status_check
charges_status_check.value:
case "charges"."status"
        when 'open' then "charges"."payment_id" is null and "charges"."paid_at" is null and "charges"."waived_at" is null
        when 'paid' then "charges"."payment_id" is not null and "charges"."paid_at" is not null and "charges"."waived_at" is null
        else "charges"."payment_id" is null and "charges"."paid_at" is null and "charges"."waived_at" is not null and ("charges"."waived_by_staff_id" is not null or "charges"."kind" = 'directory_ad')
      end

payments_needing_attention_idx.name: payments_needing_attention_idx
payments_needing_attention_idx.where: "payments"."attention_reason" is not null and "payments"."attention_resolved_at" is null

payments_attention_resolved_check.name: payments_attention_resolved_check
payments_attention_resolved_check.value: ("payments"."attention_resolved_at" is null) = ("payments"."attention_resolved_by_staff_id" is null) and ("payments"."attention_resolved_at" is null or "payments"."attention_reason" is not null)

payments_manual_details_check.name: payments_manual_details_check
payments_manual_details_check.value: case when "payments"."provider" = 'manual' then "payments"."manual_reference" is not null and "payments"."received_on" is not null else "payments"."manual_reference" is null and "payments"."received_on" is null and "payments"."recorded_by_staff_id" is null end

payments_manual_reference_check.name: payments_manual_reference_check
payments_manual_reference_check.value: "payments"."manual_reference" is null or (char_length("payments"."manual_reference") between 1 and 100 and "payments"."manual_reference" = btrim("payments"."manual_reference"))

business_closures_note_check.name: business_closures_note_check
business_closures_note_check.value: "business_closures"."note" is null or char_length("business_closures"."note") between 1 and 80

listing_content_about_check.name: listing_content_about_check
listing_content_about_check.value: "listing_content"."about" is null or char_length("listing_content"."about") between 1 and 160

directory_ad_prices_amounts_check.name: directory_ad_prices_amounts_check
directory_ad_prices_amounts_check.value: "directory_ad_prices"."top_week_paise" between 10000 and 10000000 and "directory_ad_prices"."top_week_paise" % 100 = 0 and "directory_ad_prices"."side_week_paise" between 10000 and 10000000 and "directory_ad_prices"."side_week_paise" % 100 = 0

directory_ad_wins_status_check.name: directory_ad_wins_status_check
directory_ad_wins_status_check.value:
case "directory_ad_wins"."status"
        when 'awaiting_payment' then "directory_ad_wins"."paid_at" is null and "directory_ad_wins"."lapsed_at" is null
        when 'paid' then "directory_ad_wins"."paid_at" is not null and "directory_ad_wins"."lapsed_at" is null
        else "directory_ad_wins"."paid_at" is null and "directory_ad_wins"."lapsed_at" is not null
      end

directory_claims_decided_check.name: directory_claims_decided_check
directory_claims_decided_check.value: ("directory_claims"."status" = 'pending') = ("directory_claims"."decided_at" is null) and ("directory_claims"."decided_at" is null) = ("directory_claims"."decided_by_user_id" is null)

directory_claims_tagline_check.name: directory_claims_tagline_check
directory_claims_tagline_check.value: "directory_claims"."tagline" is null or (char_length("directory_claims"."tagline") between 1 and 80 and "directory_claims"."tagline" = btrim("directory_claims"."tagline") and "directory_claims"."tagline" !~ '[\r\n]')

directory_claims_street_address_check.name: directory_claims_street_address_check
directory_claims_street_address_check.value: ("directory_claims"."origin" = 'added') = ("directory_claims"."street_address" is not null) and ("directory_claims"."street_address" is null or (char_length("directory_claims"."street_address") between 1 and 200 and "directory_claims"."street_address" = btrim("directory_claims"."street_address") and "directory_claims"."street_address" !~ '[\r\n]'))

directory_staff_ads_tagline_check.name: directory_staff_ads_tagline_check
directory_staff_ads_tagline_check.value: "directory_staff_ads"."tagline" is null or (char_length("directory_staff_ads"."tagline") between 1 and 80 and "directory_staff_ads"."tagline" = btrim("directory_staff_ads"."tagline") and "directory_staff_ads"."tagline" !~ '[\r\n]')

directory_staff_ads_agreed_check.name: directory_staff_ads_agreed_check
directory_staff_ads_agreed_check.value: "directory_staff_ads"."agreed_paise" is null or ("directory_staff_ads"."agreed_paise" between 0 and 10000000 and "directory_staff_ads"."agreed_paise" % 100 = 0)

directory_staff_ads_note_check.name: directory_staff_ads_note_check
directory_staff_ads_note_check.value: "directory_staff_ads"."note" is null or (char_length("directory_staff_ads"."note") between 1 and 200 and "directory_staff_ads"."note" = btrim("directory_staff_ads"."note"))

directory_pictures_decided_check.name: directory_pictures_decided_check
directory_pictures_decided_check.value: ("directory_pictures"."status" = 'pending') = ("directory_pictures"."decided_at" is null) and ("directory_pictures"."decided_at" is null) = ("directory_pictures"."decided_by_user_id" is null)

directory_enquiries_kind_check.name: directory_enquiries_kind_check
directory_enquiries_kind_check.value: ("directory_enquiries"."kind" = 'business' and "directory_enquiries"."listing_key" is not null and "directory_enquiries"."business_name" is not null) or ("directory_enquiries"."kind" = 'top_list' and "directory_enquiries"."listing_key" is null and "directory_enquiries"."business_name" is null)

directory_enquiries_handled_check.name: directory_enquiries_handled_check
directory_enquiries_handled_check.value: ("directory_enquiries"."status" = 'handled' and "directory_enquiries"."handled_at" is not null) or ("directory_enquiries"."status" = 'new' and "directory_enquiries"."handled_at" is null and "directory_enquiries"."handled_by_user_id" is null)

directory_reviews_text_check.name: directory_reviews_text_check
directory_reviews_text_check.value: "directory_reviews"."text" is null or char_length("directory_reviews"."text") between 1 and 500

directory_reviews_hidden_check.name: directory_reviews_hidden_check
directory_reviews_hidden_check.value: ("directory_reviews"."status" = 'hidden' and "directory_reviews"."hidden_at" is not null) or ("directory_reviews"."status" = 'published' and "directory_reviews"."hidden_at" is null and "directory_reviews"."hidden_by_user_id" is null)

business_hours_open_times_check.name: business_hours_open_times_check
business_hours_open_times_check.value:
("business_hours"."closed" and not "business_hours"."open_all_day")
        or ("business_hours"."open_all_day" and not "business_hours"."closed" and "business_hours"."opens_at" is null and "business_hours"."closes_at" is null)
        or (not "business_hours"."closed" and not "business_hours"."open_all_day" and "business_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "business_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "business_hours"."opens_at" <> "business_hours"."closes_at")

practitioner_hours_open_times_check.name: practitioner_hours_open_times_check
practitioner_hours_open_times_check.value:
("practitioner_hours"."closed" and not "practitioner_hours"."open_all_day")
        or ("practitioner_hours"."open_all_day" and not "practitioner_hours"."closed" and "practitioner_hours"."opens_at" is null and "practitioner_hours"."closes_at" is null)
        or (not "practitioner_hours"."closed" and not "practitioner_hours"."open_all_day" and "practitioner_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "practitioner_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "practitioner_hours"."opens_at" <> "practitioner_hours"."closes_at")

practitioner_leave_note_check.name: practitioner_leave_note_check
practitioner_leave_note_check.value: "practitioner_leave"."note" is null or char_length("practitioner_leave"."note") between 1 and 80

practitioners_title_check.name: practitioners_title_check
practitioners_title_check.value: "practitioners"."title" is null or char_length("practitioners"."title") between 1 and 80

referral_codes_discount_check.name: referral_codes_discount_check
referral_codes_discount_check.value: ("referral_codes"."discount_kind" = 'amount' and "referral_codes"."discount_amount_cents" is not null and "referral_codes"."discount_amount_cents" > 0 and "referral_codes"."discount_percent_basis_points" is null) or ("referral_codes"."discount_kind" = 'percent' and "referral_codes"."discount_percent_basis_points" is not null and "referral_codes"."discount_percent_basis_points" between 1 and 9900 and "referral_codes"."discount_amount_cents" is null)

referral_codes_reward_check.name: referral_codes_reward_check
referral_codes_reward_check.value: ("referral_codes"."reward_kind" = 'amount' and "referral_codes"."reward_amount_cents" >= 0 and "referral_codes"."reward_percent_basis_points" is null) or ("referral_codes"."reward_kind" = 'percent' and "referral_codes"."reward_percent_basis_points" is not null and "referral_codes"."reward_percent_basis_points" between 1 and 10000 and "referral_codes"."reward_amount_cents" = 0)
